projects.title: AI Surveillance: Multi-Camera Localisation, Threat Prioritisation & Emergency Dispatch
projects.context: MSc Dissertation · University of Birmingham Dubai
projects.description: An end-to-end real-time AI surveillance system in Python (23 modules) that locates people across multiple cameras, detects gestures and collapses, prioritises threats and automatically dispatches emergency alerts.
highlights: Multi-camera person localisation via homography calibration and cross-camera person Re-ID (ResNet).
Skeleton-based gesture and collapse detection (MediaPipe + LSTM-SVM) with a threat-prioritisation engine explained using SHAP.
Live Flask / Socket.IO dashboard and automated emergency dispatch via Twilio.
Collapse detection F1 0.91 (precision 1.00); alert threshold tuned from 0.90 to 0.75 to auto-dispatch 76% of collapses at a 4.1% full-system false-alarm rate.
Re-ID rank-1 accuracy of 87.1% on Market-1501, with WildTrack held out for evaluation (no training leakage).

projects.title: MRI Brain Segmentation — 2D & 3D Methods
projects.context: MSc · Computer Vision · University of Birmingham Dubai
projects.description: Benchmarked three methods for multi-tissue brain MRI segmentation.
highlights: Compared 2D Otsu, 2D K-Means and 3D K-Means, adding a 3×3×3 (27-voxel) majority filter for noise reduction.
Evaluated all methods with Dice Score; Otsu 2D achieved the best result (Dice 0.3821), outperforming clustering where label alignment is hard.

projects.title: Heart Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning
projects.context: B.Tech Final Year Project · GITAM University
projects.description: Classification models on clinical data for clinical decision support.
highlights: Built and compared 3 classification models (Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest) with feature selection.
Evaluated on 4 metrics: accuracy, precision, recall and ROC-AUC.

projects.title: Handwritten Digit Recognition Using CNN
projects.description: A convolutional neural network for 10-class handwritten digit classification.
highlights: Designed a CNN with convolution, pooling and dense layers in TensorFlow/Keras.
Achieved high accuracy through hyperparameter tuning.
